title: Concept Vector Composition for Intersecting Identities in Bias Steering

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear causal chain: if additive composition of bias vectors fails for intersectional bias, this directly demonstrates a limitation of current steering methods for fairness, motivating higher-order methods. Each link is explicit.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires extracting concept vectors and working with contrastive datasets for multiple bias dimensions. BBQ benchmark is publicly available. Medium compute suffices for a single model. Beginners would need mentor guidance on vector extraction but the methodology is well-documented in Beaglehole et al.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Moderately focused: extract individual bias vectors, compose them, compare to directly extracted intersectional vectors. However, constructing quality intersectional contrastive pairs and validating on BBQ adds scope. Risk of expanding to too many identity combinations.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
